description_en: Grants permissions to Threat Analysis and creates the AliyunServiceRoleForSasCloudSiem service-linked role
description_zh: 用户授权接口，点击将创建威胁分析角色AliyunServiceRoleForSasCloudSiem
name: EnableAccessForCloudSiem

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to automatically add alert logs from Security Center, Web Application Firewall (WAF), and Cloud Firewall. By default, alert logs are automatically added
parameters.help_zh: 是否自动接入云安全中心、Web应用防火墙、云防火墙的告警日志，默认自动接入
parameters.name: auto_submit

parameters.help_en:
The type of the view.

0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

1: The view of all member accounts
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The user ID of a member. An administrator can use this parameter to switch to the perspective of the specified member
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The region of the Data Management center for Threat Analysis. Select the region based on where your assets are located. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).

ap-southeast-1: Your assets are in regions outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id
